sample_mapping_evidence: 8 original CD45-selected PBMC draws/8 source people; two each HC, CD, axSpA, CD-axSpA

source_processing: 10X Genomics library sequence fastq files aligned and cell gene expression matrices generated with Cellranger v2.0.0 cellranger count with default settings
Created Seurat object for each sample with Seurat Read10X
Subset each seurat object to keep nFeature_RNA >200 and <4000, percent.mt<10 & nCount_RNA<20000
Removed batch effects with FindIntegrationAnchors, dims=1:20 and IntegrateData, dims=1:20
Clusters defined with FindNeighbors, reduction=“pca”, dims=1:20 and FindClusters, resolution=0.25
source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original deposited matrix barcode rows; source cell-calling status is not inferred from dimensions. Apply unchanged500RNAcounts before conversion. Original RNA coordinate/value audit covers all source rows; retained per-barcode RNA statistics independently pin subsequent QC.

title: Patient 2 Blood
characteristics_ch1: disease state: Co-morbid Crohn's and Spondyloarthritis
extract_protocol_ch1: For colon tissue: 30 pinch biopsies were tkaen from the rectoSignoid colon of each patient. Tissue was frozen in liquid nitrogen until use. Thawed tissue was treated with type 4 collagenase for 30 minutes and strained through a 100 micron filter. Cells were stained for Viability and CD45 and sorted for live CD45+ on an Astrios EQ

For Peripheral blood: Whole blood was collewcted in a Potassium EDTA tube, blood was layered on ficolla and centrifuged at 1200RPM for 20 minutes. Buffy Coat layer was collected and stained for CD45 and viability. CD45+ live cells were collected on an Astrios EQ.
data_processing: 10X Genomics library sequence fastq files aligned and cell gene expression matrices generated with Cellranger v2.0.0 cellranger count with default settings

Removed batch effects with FindIntegrationAnchors, dims=1:20 and IntegrateData, dims=1:20
Clusters defined with FindNeighbors, reduction=“pca”, dims=1:20 and FindClusters, resolution=0.25
contact_institute: University of Colorado School of Medicine

metadata.source_specimen: Ficoll-separated peripheral blood; live CD45-positive cells sorted before scRNA-seq
metadata.source_coverage_policy: CD45 selection and source viability sorting may change composition; not an unbiased unsorted PBMC measurement.
metadata.source_identity_policy: Eight explicit Patient title codes each have one blood RNA record; paired colon records excluded. Source filename prefixes are library codes, not extra donors.
metadata.source_count_policy: Original deposited CellRanger2.0.0 triplets; native gene IDs/symbols and integer counts retained. Source Seurat integration is not used for geometry.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: No numerical age, sex, medication or calendar-date join inferred from participant numbers alone.
metadata.source_missingness_policy: Missing demographic fields, genes and cell types are not imputed or zero-filled.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; donor code retained, cross-study identity unresolved
